newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BES sees good performance in 1997.
newsitem.headline: BES sees good performance in 1997.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Espirito Santo expects to post a good performance in 1997 but it will be hard to maintain profit growth of around 20 percent, BES's president Ricardo Espirito Santo Salgado said.
"It is natural that we will continue to grow well," he told Reuters. "We believe that 1997 will also be a good year."
He added: "But to maintain profit growth of around 20 percent would be very difficult. We cannot predict such a level of profit growth."
Salgado was speaking after the bank announced a 21.3 percent increase year-on-year in its 1996 profit to 23.59 billion escudos.
